integrity: The analytic proof is supplied in RESULT.md and an exact-rational independent finite check in verify.py; finite tests are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns all-dimensional Euclidean parallelotopes, not arbitrary polytopes; the published three-dimensional orthogonal-cutout tiling correspondence is not asserted in higher dimensions. Historical priority is provisionally assessed from bounded searches, and no independent audit was performed.
title: Gram-diagonal-dominance classification of all-face projection kernels of parallelotopes
